description:
## [1.43.0](https://github.com/BlazeFTL/FTL-Patches/compare/v1.42.0...v1.43.0) (2026-09-05)

### 📱 App-Specific Patches
* **MX Player**
  * ✨ Added Remove Bottom Bar And Add Me Tab To Top.
  * 🐛 Added Clean Me Tab
  * 🐛 Added Add NetWork Stream To Me Tab Patch.
* **XFolder (File Manager)**
  * ✨ Added Unlock Pro patch.
  * ✨ Added Disable Rate Dialog patch (turns off cleaner by default).
* **WPS Suite**
  * ✨ Added **WpsApp Pro** Bypass License Check patch.
  * ✨ Added **WPS WPA Tester Pro** patch.
* **WiFi Analyzer**
  * ✨ Added WiFi Analyzer Pro patch.
  * ✨ Added Disable Rate Dialog patch. *(Recovered from dev cycle)*
* **RS File Explorer**
  * ✨ Added Clean Sidebar patch.
  * **ES File Explorer**
  * ✨ Made patch significantly more robust against R8 obfuscation.
* **Video Downloader / All Video Downloader**
  * ✨ Restricted patch compatibility to version `2.7.2`.
  * ✨ Added Signature patch, Skip Splash, and Language patches.
* **Bangla Dictionary Pro**
  * ✨ Added new Pro unlock patch.
* **Save Data Tools**
  * ✨ Added Add Save Data Patch

### 🌐 Universal & General Patches
* **APK Junk Cleaner**
  * ✨ Prepared patch for new API integration.
  * 🐛 Cleaned up, restored, and stabilized patch logic after testing.
* **Analytics Remover**
  * ✨ Added new universal Analytics removal patch.
  * 🐛 Removed specific analytics components that were causing app crashes.
  * 🐛 Improved R8 obfuscation compatibility for analytics removal.
* **Universal Ad Removal**
  * ✨ Updated "Remove Ads Lite (Adobo)" configurations to cover more ad SDKs.
* **Splash Screen**
  * ✨ Added universal "Skip Splash Expert" patch.
* **Certificate & Security**
  * ✨ Hide APK Cert" patch.
* **Toast Notifications**
  * ✨ Updated Toast patch; removed junk toast notifications.

### 🛠️ Build & Infrastructure
* 🐛 Restored `gradlew` executable bit (resolved multiple build permission issues).
* 🐛 Applied general stability fixes for Morphe Dev compatibility.
